theater: 中越邊境廣西與雲南兩線戰區

battle.name: 中越戰爭
battle.theater: 中越邊境廣西與雲南兩線戰區
battle.brief: 一九七九年二月十七日拂曉，解放軍以九個軍二十九個步兵師、約二十二萬兵力自廣西與雲南兩線越境，十七天內攻取高平、諒山、老街等城鎮，三月十六日全軍撤回。全役純屬陸戰，海空兩軍僅在境內執勤：殲-6等數百架次戰鬥機在中越邊境空域巡邏警戒，護衛境內機場，未曾與越軍交戰。

kit.name: 殲-6戰鬥機
kit.history: 殲-6是人民空軍早期的主力制空戰鬥機，主要承擔高空攔截與空域防衛任務，並與其他戰鬥機共同構成邊境方向的空中防線。

countries: 交戰方是中華人民共和國與越南社會主義共和國，這是冷戰後期社會主義國家之間罕見的正面熱戰。中方最高決策層是中共中央軍事委員會，當時由主席華國鋒主持，副主席兼總參謀長鄧小平主持作戰，國防部長徐向前參與決策；具體作戰計畫由昆明軍區與廣州軍區分別承擔，雲南方面先後由楊得志、張銹秀指揮，廣西方面由許世友指揮。中國人民解放軍共投入九個軍二十九個步兵師，另有兩個炮兵師、三個高射炮兵師，以及鐵道兵、工程兵、通信兵等保障部隊，總兵力約二十二萬人，在約五百公里的戰線上展開。空軍航空兵出動各型飛機七百餘架次，在中越邊境空域加強巡邏警戒，一般不進入越南境內作戰，同時做好支援地面部隊的準備；境內機場與重要目標的對空保衛，由高射炮兵師與地空導彈部隊擔負。海軍南海艦隊組建代號二一七的合成艦艇編隊，在中國南部沿海港口集結各型艦艇待命，負責牽制越軍在南海方向的動向。越方由越共中央軍委第一書記黎筍與中央軍委第一副書記文進勇主持，前線作戰由越南人民軍總參謀部指揮，范文同出任政府總理。越軍以六個步兵師組成第一線，另有十餘個地方團、二十餘個獨立營與四個炮兵團配合，後期再投入步兵三二七師、三三七師等部隊，參戰正規軍約十萬人，並有數量龐大的武裝民兵擔任邊防與游擊任務。外圍還有第三方角色：蘇聯於一九七八年十一月三日與越南簽訂帶有軍事援助性質的《蘇越友好合作條約》，並在北亞部署重兵，是中方最忌憚的變數；美國於一九七九年一月一日與中國正式建交；柬埔寨的西哈努克與宋雙一方在中方支持下重新組織武裝力量，從西線牽制越軍。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and the clash was one of the rare direct hot wars between socialist states in the late Cold War. On the Chinese side the highest decision-making body was the Central Military Commission of the Chinese Communist Party, chaired at the time by Hua Guofeng, with Deng Xiaoping as deputy chairman and chief of the general staff running the operations and Defence Minister Xu Xiangqian taking part in the deliberations. The operational plans were carried by the Kunming and Guangzhou military regions separately: the Yunnan front was commanded first by Yang Dezhi and then by Zhang Zhixiu, while the Guangxi front was under Xu Shiyou. The People's Liberation Army committed nine corps and twenty-nine infantry divisions, together with two artillery divisions, three antiaircraft artillery divisions and supporting engineer, railway and signals troops, for a total of about 220,000 men deployed along a front of roughly five hundred kilometres. The Air Force flew more than seven hundred sorties of assorted aircraft to step up patrol and alert in the Sino-Vietnamese border airspace, generally not entering Vietnamese territory to fight, while making preparations to support the ground forces; the defence of airfields and key targets inside China was assigned to the antiaircraft artillery divisions and the surface-to-air missile troops. The South Sea Fleet of the Navy formed a composite task force with the code number 217, gathering a range of warships in ports along the southern Chinese coast as a stand-by force to pin down Vietnamese activity in the South Sea. On the Vietnamese side the leadership sat with Le Duc Anh, First Secretary of the Central Military Commission of the Vietnamese Communist Party, and Van Tien Dung, First Deputy Secretary of the same commission, with the General Staff of the People's Army of Vietnam running the front-line fighting and Pham Van Dong serving as head of government. The Vietnamese army built its first line around six infantry divisions, supported by more than ten local regiments, over twenty independent battalions and four artillery regiments, and later added infantry divisions including the 327th and the 337th, bringing the regular troops engaged to around 100,000 men, with large numbers of armed militia handling border defence and guerrilla tasks. Third parties played roles as well. The Soviet Union signed a Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation with Vietnam on 3 November 1978 whose terms carried a military assistance character, and kept heavy forces deployed in northern Asia, which was the variable Beijing feared most. The United States established diplomatic relations with China on 1 January 1979. In Cambodia, the Sihanouk and Song Samouth factions reorganised armed forces with Chinese support and tied down Vietnamese troops on the western front.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩條戰線。中方一側，鄧小平以中央軍委副主席兼總參謀長的身份拍板出兵，把行動定性為「自衛還擊」而非進攻，事後的說法是對越南的一次有限懲罰，目標有限、手段可控、達到目的即行退兵。華國鋒以中央軍委主席身份主持一九七八年十二月七日的軍委擴大會議並下達作戰命令，葉劍英與徐向前分別以軍委副主席與國防部長身份參與謀劃。廣西方面由廣州軍區司令員許世友指揮，他以多個軍級單位組成東線兵團，自友誼關方向一路打到同登與諒山，攻下鬼屯砲台是全役最著名的戰果；三月一日他集中十九個炮兵營三百零六門火炮，三十分鐘內向諒山市區三十三個目標發射九千九百餘發炮彈，三月四日推進到淇窮江以南五公里，與攻占迷邁山的部隊共同形成威逼河內的態勢；三月五日奉命開始撤退，五月三十日率前指由南寧班師返回廣州。雲南方面在開戰前發生一次臨陣易帥，原武漢軍區司令員楊得志與昆明軍區司令員王必成對調職務，一九七九年一月七日楊得志飛抵昆明上任，開戰後在開遠前指日夜關注戰局、調配兵力，二月二十五日突發急病，二十六日被專機秘密送回北京治療，由昆明軍區副司令員張銹秀代理司令員，率西線完成攻占老街、班賽、封土的戰役並按期撤回。作戰單位中，第十三軍三十九師在代乃方向頂住越軍三一六A師反擊的表現最為突出。越方一側，越共中央總書記兼中央軍委書記黎筍是最高決策者，越軍總參謀長文進勇主持前線作戰，越南人民軍的將領名錄中還有范雄、黎仲迅、黃扁山、麻永蘭、阮海鵬、武立等人，國家主席為孫德勝，副總參謀長伍修權則在中方對外發言時提供傷亡數字。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities divide cleanly between the two fronts. On the Chinese side Deng Xiaoping, deputy chairman of the Central Military Commission and chief of the general staff, authorised the campaign and framed the operation as a counterattack in self-defence rather than an aggression; the line afterwards was that this was a limited punishment of Vietnam, with limited objectives, controllable methods and withdrawal as soon as the purpose was achieved. Hua Guofeng, chairman of the Central Military Commission, presided over the enlarged commission meeting of 7 December 1978 that issued the order to fight, with Ye Jianying and Xu Xiangqian taking part in the planning as deputy chairman and defence minister. On the Guangxi front Xu Shiyou, commander of the Guangzhou Military Region, grouped several corps into the eastern task force and drove from the Friendship Pass towards Dong Dang and Lang Son; the taking of the Ghost Tun fortification was the best known action of the campaign. On 1 March he concentrated nineteen artillery battalions and three hundred and six guns, and in thirty minutes fired more than 9,900 shells at thirty-three targets inside Lang Son, reducing the city to a standstill; on 4 March his troops pushed five kilometres south of the Quang Hung river, forming together with the units that had seized Mi Mai mountain a stance threatening Hanoi. Ordered to withdraw on 5 March, he led the forward headquarters home from Nanning on 30 May. On the Yunnan front there was a last-minute exchange of commanders before the battle: Yang Dezhi, then commander of the Wuhan Military Region, and Wang Bicheng, commander of the Kunming Military Region, swapped posts, and on 7 January 1979 Yang Dezhi flew to Kunming to take up the command. During the fighting he watched the situation day and night from the forward headquarters at Kaiyuan and shifted the deployment of troops; on 25 February he was taken ill, and on the 26th he was flown back to Beijing in a special aircraft for treatment, Zhang Zhixiu, deputy commander of the Kunming Military Region, taking over as acting commander and leading the western front through the capture of Lao Cai, Ban Sai and Feng Tu and the withdrawal on schedule. Among the individual units, the 39th Regiment of the 13th Corps distinguished itself at Dai Nai, where it absorbed repeated counterattacks by the Vietnamese 316A Division. On the Vietnamese side Le Duc Anh, General Secretary of the Vietnamese Communist Party and Secretary of its Central Military Commission, was the supreme decision maker, and Van Tien Dung directed the front-line operations as chief of the general staff. The roster of Vietnamese People's Army commanders also included Fan Xiong, Ly Trong Xuan, Hoang Bien Son, Ma Yong Lan, Nguyen Hai Peng and Wu Li; Sun Duong was President of the state, and Deputy Chief of the General Staff Wu Xiuquan supplied the casualty figures when China spoke to foreign military delegations.
kits: 卡面的殲-6戰鬥機是這場戰爭空軍一側的骨幹，但必須說清楚一點：這是一場純粹的陸地戰爭，殲-6自始至終沒有取得空戰戰果。中國人民空軍航空兵奉命在中越邊境空域加強巡邏警戒，各型飛機出動七百餘架次，一般不進入越南境內作戰，同時做好支援地面部隊的準備；空軍高炮兵師與地空導彈部隊另擔負中國境內機場與重要目標的對空保衛。殲-6是仿製蘇聯米格-19S型而成的國產第一代噴氣式截擊機，一九五六年首飛、一九五八年定型，由瀋陽飛機工業部批量生產，總產量在千架以上；機體換裝國產渦噴-7發動機，其後改用推力更大的WP-7A，最大平飛速度可達一點四倍音速，實用升限一萬五千米以上，最大爬升率逾百五十米每秒，高空高速性能在當時的中國空軍中最為突出，武器為一門三十七毫米二十三-三十機炮與兩門三十毫米三十-一機炮。它原本是為攔截高空轟炸機而設計，掛載炸彈的能力來自國產改型：改裝後可在翼下六個掛點上掛載一百公斤或二百五十公斤炸彈與火箭巢，這一能力直到一九八四年的兩山戰役才被大規模用於對地攻擊，一九七九年則主要用於邊境攔截與防空戒備。地面裝備方面，解放軍步兵以五三式與五六式半自動步槍、六三式自動步槍為主，配四〇火箭筒與六七式八二毫米無後坐力炮，炮兵有七五、一二二毫米各型火炮，裝甲為五九式與六二式中型戰車；越軍裝備有相當數量的AK-47與五六式衝鋒槍、RPG火箭筒，雙方都大量使用地雷、竹制陷阱與鹿砦。運輸上，雲南方向依賴昆明至河口的公路與滇越鐵路遺留的通道，廣西方向依賴南寧至憑祥的鐵路與友誼關公路，後勤車輛以解放牌卡車為主，廣西與雲南兩省組織民兵與民夫支前。
kitsEn: The J-6 fighter on the card face was the backbone of the air arm in this war, but one point has to be made clear: this was a purely land war, and the J-6 never scored an air combat victory. The PLA Air Force was ordered to step up patrol and alert in the Sino-Vietnamese border airspace, flying more than seven hundred sorties of assorted aircraft, generally without entering Vietnamese territory to fight, while making ready to support the ground forces; the antiaircraft artillery divisions and the surface-to-air missile troops separately took on the defence of airfields and key targets inside China. The J-6 was a Chinese-built first generation jet interceptor derived from the Soviet MiG-19S, first flying in 1956 and type-certified in 1958, and mass-produced by the Shenyang Aircraft Factory to a total of well over a thousand aircraft. The airframe was re-engined with the indigenous WP-7 turbojet and later the more powerful WP-7A, giving a maximum level speed of about Mach 1.4, a practical ceiling above 15,000 metres and a maximum climb rate exceeding 150 metres per second, which made it the best high-altitude and high-speed performer in the Chinese air force of the day; its armament was one 37mm 23-30 cannon and two 30mm 30-1 cannon. It had been designed to intercept high-altitude bombers, and its ability to carry bombs came from Chinese modification: the adapted version could carry 100kg or 250kg bombs and rocket pods on six underwing hardpoints. That capability was not turned into large-scale ground attack until the 1984 conflict over the Two Mountains, and in 1979 the type was employed chiefly for border interception and air defence readiness. On the ground, PLA infantry were armed mainly with Type 53 and Type 56 semi-automatic rifles and Type 63 assault rifles, supported by 40mm rocket launchers and Type 67 82mm recoilless rifles; the artillery included 75mm and 122mm guns of various types and the armour consisted of Type 59 and Type 62 medium tanks. The Vietnamese forces carried substantial numbers of AK-47 and Type 56 submachine guns and RPG launchers, and both sides made heavy use of mines, bamboo traps and deer-stake barricades. On logistics, the Yunnan front depended on the road from Kunming to Hekou and the corridor left by the old Yunnan-Indochina railway, while the Guangxi front depended on the Nanning-Pingxiang railway and the Friendship Pass highway; transport vehicles were mostly Liberation trucks, and the two provinces of Guangxi and Yunnan mobilised militia and civilian porters to support the front.
tactics: 中方的作戰計畫是典型的有限戰爭樣式：目標限於越北淺近縱深的縣城與城鎮，原計畫先用三到五天消滅越軍一至兩個師，一九七八年十二月二十一日軍委再次決定擴大戰線與目標，把作戰時間延長到十五到二十天，消滅三至五個師，並全線投入更多野戰軍。展開方式是兩線同時發動：一九七九年二月十七日拂曉，廣西方向四個軍及保障部隊近十二萬人分十四路越境，雲南方向三個軍及保障部隊十餘萬人同時自三個方向攻入，越軍第一線很快被切斷。戰術上解放軍沿公路縱深穿插，以三三制分散隊形推進，用炮兵火力急襲配合步兵衝鋒，二月十七日四十二軍一二六師自布局關出奇奪取東溪即是典型；三月一日五十五軍集中十九個炮兵營三百零六門火炮，對諒山市區三十三個目標實施三十分鐘火力急襲，九千九百餘發炮彈把市區打成癱瘓，隨後步兵占領北市區，三月四日推進到淇窮江以南。越軍的戰術以山林地防禦與游擊反擊為主：高平、同登、諒山一線依托天然地障構築鹿砦、坑道與竹制陷阱，反擊集中打解放軍的側後與補給線，第三一六A師在代乃方向的多次反攻即為代表。撤退階段是全役最被低估的環節：三月五日晚中方宣布已達到懲罰作戰目的，三月六日起以交替掩護、邊清剿邊撤退的方式逐段後撤，東線在友誼關方向鋪設地雷並以遠程砲火掩護，阻止越軍追擊，三月十二日諒山方向率先完成撤軍，三月十三日西線全部退回國境線以內，三月十六日二十二時二十分最後一輛軍車回到中國領土。
tacticsEn: The Chinese operational plan followed the classic pattern of a limited war: the objectives were confined to the county towns and small cities of the shallow northern depths of Vietnam, and the original plan was to destroy one or two Vietnamese divisions in three to five days. On 21 December 1978 the commission decided once more to widen the front and the objectives, extending the operation to fifteen or twenty days and the destruction of three to five divisions, and committing more field corps across the line. The manner of opening was simultaneous on two axes: at first light on 17 February 1979 nearly 120,000 men of four corps and their supporting troops on the Guangxi front crossed the border in fourteen columns, while on the Yunnan front more than 100,000 men of three corps and supporting troops entered from three directions at the same time, and the Vietnamese first line was cut apart very quickly. Tactically the PLA pushed in depth along the roads, dispersed in three-man fire teams, and combined massed artillery fire with infantry assault; the capture of Dong Xi by the 126th Regiment of the 42nd Corps from Bu Ju Guan on 17 February was a textbook example. On 1 March the 55th Corps concentrated nineteen artillery battalions and three hundred and six guns for a thirty-minute fire sweep against thirty-three targets in Lang Son, and more than 9,900 shells left the city paralysed, after which the infantry took the northern city and on 4 March pushed south of the Quang Hung river. The Vietnamese tactical method was one of forest and mountain defence combined with guerrilla counterattack: the lines at Cao Bang, Dong Dang and Lang Son relied on natural barriers, and deer-stake barricades, tunnels and bamboo traps, and their counterattacks were aimed at the flanks and the supply lines of the Chinese columns, the repeated attacks of the 316A Division at Dai Nai being representative. The withdrawal phase is the most underrated part of the whole operation: on the evening of 5 March Beijing announced that the punitive objective had been achieved, and from 6 March the troops pulled back segment by segment under mutually covering protection, clearing and withdrawing at the same time. On the eastern front they laid mines along the route out through the Friendship Pass and covered the withdrawal with long-range artillery fire, which prevented the Vietnamese from mounting a large pursuit. The Lang Son sector completed its withdrawal first on 12 March, the whole western front was back inside the border by 13 March, and at 22:20 on 16 March the last army vehicle crossed onto Chinese territory.
data: 時間、兵力、距離與損失是這場戰爭的基本數字。作戰自一九七九年二月十七日拂曉開始，至三月十六日二十二時二十分最後一輛軍車越過國境線，前後二十八天，其中正面作戰十七天、撤軍十一天。中方投入九個軍二十九個步兵師、兩個炮兵師、三個高射炮兵師，兵力約二十二萬人，戰線約五百公里；越軍參戰正規軍約十萬人，第一線為六個步兵師，另有地方團、獨立營與大量武裝民兵。傷亡數字是全役最混亂的一組資料：官方當年沒有公布中方傷亡人數，後來昆明軍區後勤部《對越自衛反擊作戰工作總結》記錄廣西、雲南參戰的解放軍與支前民兵共六千九百五十四人死亡、一萬四千八百餘人受傷；副總參謀長伍修權在會見外國軍事代表團時則稱越南傷亡五萬、中國傷亡兩萬；英國廣播公司的推算是中國軍隊傷亡約二萬七千人、越軍傷亡約八萬人，各方說法彼此矛盾。越南官方長期未正式公布本方傷亡數字，直到上世紀八十年代才有零星統計流出。裝備方面，中方公布繳獲越軍各種槍砲數千件、各型火砲數百門，坦克與裝甲車數十輛；越方記錄的損失包括四百二十八家醫院與七百三十五所學校被毀、八萬頃農田受損，以及四十萬頭牛被殺或被擄。中國此役直接經濟損失約三十五億人民幣。雙方陸地疆界全長約一千三百公里，此役沒有劃定任何新界線，友誼關與板約瀑布一帶約八十平方公里的爭議地帶直到二〇〇〇年《中越陸地邊界條約》簽訂後才歸入中國。
dataEn: Time, strength, distance and loss give the basic numbers of this war. The fighting began at first light on 17 February 1979 and ended when the last army vehicle crossed the border at 22:20 on 16 March, twenty-eight days in all, of which seventeen were spent in the main battle and eleven in the withdrawal. China committed nine corps and twenty-nine infantry divisions with two artillery divisions and three antiaircraft artillery divisions, about 220,000 men, along a front of some five hundred kilometres. Vietnam fielded regular troops of around 100,000, with six infantry divisions in the first line, plus local regiments, independent battalions and a large number of armed militia. Casualty figures are the most confused set of data in the whole operation: no official Chinese casualty figure was published at the time, and it was only later that the Kunming Military Region logistics department's summary of the counterattack recorded 6,954 dead and more than 14,800 wounded among the PLA troops and the militia who supported them in Guangxi and Yunnan. Deputy Chief of the General Staff Wu Xiuquan told a foreign military delegation that Vietnam had lost 50,000 and China 20,000; the British Broadcasting Corporation estimated Chinese military casualties at about 27,000 and Vietnamese at about 80,000. The accounts contradict one another. Vietnam published no official casualty figure of its own for a long time, and only stray statistics surfaced in the 1980s. As for equipment, China announced the capture of several thousand rifles and guns of all types, several hundred pieces of artillery and several dozen tanks and armoured vehicles; the losses recorded on the Vietnamese side include 428 hospitals and 735 schools destroyed, 80,000 hectares of farmland damaged and 400,000 head of cattle killed or taken. The direct economic cost to China is put at about 3.5 billion renminbi. The land frontier between the two countries runs for about 1,300 kilometres, and this war fixed no new line; the disputed ground around the Friendship Pass and the Ban Don waterfall, roughly 80 square kilometres, was not allocated to China until the Sino-Vietnamese Land Border Treaty of 2000.
cause: 這場戰爭的成因有遠有近。遠因是國際格局：中蘇在一九六九年珍寶島衝突之後交惡，越南在一九七五年統一後轉而與蘇聯靠近，一九七八年六月二十九日加入以蘇聯為首的經濟互助委員會，同年十一月三日又與蘇聯簽訂帶有軍事援助性質的《蘇越友好合作條約》；中國擔心蘇越聯手在亞洲建立集體安全體系，把整個南部邊疆置於對方包圍之下。近因是邊境衝突與華僑問題：越南全國國有化之後排華事件頻仍，一九七八年八月二十五日發生友誼關事件，越方軍警拆除華僑搭建的草棚並毆打驅趕華僑，造成中方人員傷亡，數千名華僑湧入中國境內，中越副外長級談判因此中斷。直接原因則在柬埔寨：波爾布建立的民主柬埔寨政權在內部大清洗之後垮台，一九七八年十二月二十五日越軍十萬人攻入柬埔寨，一九七九年一月七日占領金邊；中國扶持西哈努克與宋雙一方，並擔心越軍占領柬埔寨後獲得蘇制裝備，對中國南部邊境形成直接的軍事威脅。時機又與中美關係掛鈎：一九七九年一月一日中美正式建交，一月二十四日鄧小平訪美；在這樣的背景下出兵，被不少研究者視為向美國表明聯美抗蘇的決心，也是中越交惡最終走到兵戎的一個副產品。
causeEn: The causes of this war lie at several distances. The distant cause is the international alignment: after the clash at Zhenbao Island in 1969, China and the Soviet Union fell out, and after its reunification in 1975 Vietnam drew closer to Moscow, joining the Soviet-led Council for Mutual Economic Assistance on 29 June 1978 and signing the Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation with the Soviet Union on 3 November of the same year, a treaty whose terms carried a military assistance character. China feared that a Soviet-Vietnamese combination might build an Asian collective security system and place its entire southern frontier inside an enemy encirclement. The proximate cause lies in border incidents and the question of overseas Chinese: after the nationalisation of private business in Vietnam, persecution of the Chinese community was frequent, and on 25 August 1978 the Friendship Pass incident saw Vietnamese police and troops pull down the shelters the refugees had built and beat and drive off the Chinese residents, causing Chinese casualties, with several thousand refugees streaming into China and the deputy ministerial talks breaking down. The direct cause lay in Cambodia: after the internal purge, the Democratic Kampuchea regime of Pol Pot collapsed, Vietnamese forces of 100,000 men entered Cambodia on 25 December 1978 and took Phnom Penh on 7 January 1979. China backed the Sihanouk and Song Samouth factions and feared that a Vietnam holding Cambodia and equipped with Soviet weapons would pose a direct military threat to China's southern border. The timing was also tied to Sino-American relations: diplomatic relations were established on 1 January 1979 and Deng Xiaoping visited the United States on 24 January. Launching the campaign in that context is read by many analysts as a demonstration to Washington of a determination to stand with the United States against the Soviet Union, and as a by-product of the deterioration that finally took Sino-Vietnamese hostility to the battlefield.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了三個國家的軌道。對中國而言，此役一來打通了中美正常化的道路，換來一九八〇年代引進西方資金技術的關鍵窗口，同時把邊防軍隊的整訓、軍銜制、裝甲化與指揮體系改革推上日程，戰後總結明確指出五九式與六二式坦克不適合山地作戰、五六式半自動步槍火力不及對手、缺少裝甲運兵車與步兵戰車等缺陷。對越南而言，此役造成持續十年的邊境消耗：越軍長期維持百二十萬人的陸軍備戰，無法投入生產，經濟改革因此錯過時機；越軍大量兵力被釘在北方，無力再插手周邊鄰國的內政；此後的中越十年邊境衝突中，越軍在老山、者陰山等騎線點反覆挑釁，一九八四年解放軍發動兩山戰役收復這些山頭，之後雙方在邊境發生數千次小規模衝突，多由中方占優。戰俘與華僑問題成為最長的尾聲：一九七九年五月雙方在友誼關零公里處經由紅十字會渠道分批遣返被俘人員，而戰後對越境華人的人口結構改變延續數十年，約八萬漢族與苗族人口被從越南北部遷往南部。對柬埔寨戰局而言，中國出兵等於給了流亡一方喘息之機，抵抗武裝得以恢復，越南不得不在柬埔寨長期維持駐軍，直至一九八九年撤軍為止。
impactEn: The war shifted the course of three countries. For China it opened the road to normalisation with the United States and brought in the crucial window of the 1980s for bringing in Western capital and technology, while pushing the retraining of the border troops, the introduction of military ranks, the mechanisation of the army and the reform of the command system onto the agenda; the post-war summary named plainly the faults that had been exposed, that Type 59 and Type 62 tanks were unsuited to mountain fighting, that the Type 56 semi-automatic rifle was outgunned by the enemy's weapons, and that armoured personnel carriers and infantry fighting vehicles were missing. For Vietnam the war brought a decade of attrition along the border: the army of more than 1.2 million men was kept on permanent war footing, could not be put into production, and the country's economic reform was thereby delayed; large forces were pinned in the north and the country had no strength left to interfere in its neighbours' affairs. In the ten years of border conflict that followed, Vietnamese troops repeatedly challenged the Chinese on the contested spurs of Lao Shan and Zhe Yin Shan, and in 1984 the PLA launched the war of the Two Mountains to retake those heights; the two sides then fought several thousand small engagements along the frontier, in the majority of cases with the Chinese better placed. The prisoners of war and the question of the Chinese-speaking population formed the longest tail: in May 1979 the two sides handed over prisoners in batches through the Red Cross at the zero-kilometre mark on the Friendship Pass road, and the demographic reshaping of the Chinese communities in Vietnam ran on for decades, with roughly 80,000 Han and Miao people relocated from northern Vietnam to the south. For the Cambodian theatre, Chinese intervention gave the exiled side a breathing space, allowed the resistance to recover, and obliged Vietnam to keep troops in Cambodia for years until its withdrawal in 1989.
result: 結果是一場雙方各自宣布勝利、卻沒有任何一方取得戰場決定的有限戰爭。二月十七日開火，至三月五日晚中方宣布已達到懲罰作戰目的並開始撤軍；同日深夜越南發布全國總動員令表示抵抗到底，但數日後即接受停火。撤軍三月六日展開，東線在友誼關方向鋪設地雷並以遠程砲火掩護，阻止越軍追擊，三月十二日諒山方向率先完成，三月十三日西線全部退回國境線以內，三月十六日二十二時二十分最後一輛軍車回到中國領土，越南大部分國土未受攻佔。邊界大致回復到戰前狀態，雙方在三月十七日就各自撤出邊境、加強邊境地區軍事力量等問題簽署諒解備忘錄，標誌著這場戰爭在外交上落幕。戰俘問題長期懸而未決，直到同年五月二十一日雙方才在友誼關零公里處經由紅十字會渠道分批交換被俘傷病員，之後又經兩輪會談繼續處理。從戰略層面看，中方在十七天內達成摧毀越軍北部邊防體系與打擊其邊境首腦機關的目標，同時控制戰爭規模、避免與蘇聯直接捲入衝突，卻也付出慘重代價：越軍在北部邊境的有效控制能力被削弱後改採固守姿態，卻在隨後十年把中國拖入代價更高的邊境消耗戰。中越關係此後冰封整整十三年，直至一九八九年越南從柬埔寨撤軍、一九九一年杜梅與武文傑訪中並發表聯合公報宣布關係正常化，兩國關係才重新打開。
resultEn: The outcome was a limited war in which both sides proclaimed victory and neither achieved a battlefield decision. The fighting opened on 17 February, and by the evening of 5 March the Chinese side announced that the punitive objective had been achieved and that withdrawal would begin; late that same night Vietnam issued a general mobilisation order to resist to the end, but accepted the ceasefire several days later. The withdrawal opened on 6 March, the eastern front laying mines along the route out through the Friendship Pass and covering it with long-range artillery fire to prevent a Vietnamese pursuit; the Lang Son sector finished first on 12 March, the entire western front was back within the border by 13 March, and at 22:20 on 16 March the last army vehicle returned to Chinese soil, with the bulk of Vietnamese territory never occupied. The frontier was broadly restored to its pre-war position, and on 17 March the two sides signed memoranda on their mutual withdrawal from the border areas and on the strengthening of military forces there, which marked the diplomatic end of the war. The question of prisoners of war remained outstanding for a long time: it was only on 21 May of the same year that the two sides began handing over wounded and sick prisoners in batches through the Red Cross at the zero-kilometre point on the Friendship Pass road, followed by two further rounds of talks. Strategically, the Chinese side achieved within seventeen days the destruction of the northern Vietnamese border defence system and a strike at the command organs along the frontier, while keeping the scale of the war under control and avoiding direct entanglement with the Soviet Union, but it paid a heavy price: after the Vietnamese effective control of the northern border was degraded and they shifted to a defensive posture, they nonetheless drew China into a far more costly border war of attrition over the following ten years. Sino-Vietnamese relations were frozen for exactly thirteen years, and only after Vietnam withdrew from Cambodia in 1989 and Do Muoi and Vu Van Thuong visited China in 1991, publishing a joint communiqué declaring normalisation of relations, did the two states begin to open up to each other again.
